subject: MPS Website Updates and Phase Two
overview: The subcommittee met with the vocational web development instructor, student website team members, and the district communications director to review the relaunched district website and discuss phase two enhancements. The subcommittee voted to continue the discussion to January 2024.

items.title: Presentation and Discussion on MPS Website Updates
items.summary: Teacher Lisa Miller and student web team members presented website analytics, accessibility features, language translations, social media integration, and potential phase two priorities, including a centralized payment portal and expanded student club resources. Student Rachel proposed establishing a paid internship for students maintaining the website, prompting discussion on vocational guidelines and equity across programs, after which the subcommittee voted to continue the item to the first meeting in January 2024.
